name: Screw terminal, 3 way, 5.08 mm (Phoenix MKDS 1,5/3-5,08)
summary: Green 3-way screw terminal for a board. Wires go in from the front; the block runs 15.24 mm along the edge and stands 13.8 mm tall.
description: Three screw terminals on a 5.08 mm pitch. The body and wire openings are included.
source: Phoenix Contact catalog extract for MKDS 1,5/ 3-5,08 (order no. 1715734): the dimensioned drawing gives the body as a + 5.08 with Dimension a = 10.16 mm for three positions, so 15.24 mm wide, 9.8 mm deep and 13.8 mm tall on the board with pins 3.5 mm below, the first pin 2.54 mm in from the end on 5.08 mm pitch, 0.9 x 0.9 mm pins in 1.3 mm holes, M3 screws, wires up to 2.5 mm2 solid or 1.5 mm2 stranded stripped 7 mm, rated 17.5 A at 250 V with UL at 10 A and 300 V. The 16.28 x 6 mm slot in front and the opening for each way are our suggestion for bringing wires through a wall, not Phoenix figures. KF301 and DG128 lookalikes share the pitch but not always the height.

electrical.note: 17.5 A at 250 V to IEC; UL lists 10 A at 300 V. KF301 and DG128 lookalikes are usually rated nearer 10 A. This is a contact rating, not current drawn from the project supply.
